title: Contracts
subtitle: The signed sale agreement for this property: upload the paper-signed copy, or send one to be signed through PandaDoc.
emptyBody: Create a contract in PandaDoc, or upload the copy the customer signed.

upload.title: Upload signed contract
upload.intro: Use this when the customer signed on paper. Any PandaDoc contract still open for this property is replaced.

errors.pdf: Upload the contract as a PDF
errors.size: The file must be 10 MB or smaller
errors.title: Title is too long

create.title: Create contract in PandaDoc
create.intro: A draft is created from the template. Send it when it is ready; the buyer signs by email.

revise.title: Revise contract
revise.intro: {{title}} (version {{version}}) will be voided and a new draft version is opened in PandaDoc.
revise.noteHint: Kept with the new version, for example a corrected price or plan.

void.title: Void contract
void.message: Void {{title}}? It stays on record but is no longer valid.

signing.title: Sign {{title}}
signing.hint: The buyer signs here, in PandaDoc's own signing page. Hand the screen to {{email}}.
signing.mockNote: Test mode: this stands in for PandaDoc's signing page.
signing.signed: Signed. The contract is now final.
signing.failed: Could not open the signing page: {{message}}
